evidence.quote: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: The suite is positioned as an authority that dictates enrollment policy — it asserts a rule binding creator to reviewer role, enacting hierarchy between test framework and system behavior.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: The memory is framed as a vehicle subordinate to the suite's assertion — its existence serves the authority of the test's claim, reinforcing the ranking of assertion over artifact.
